# Preprocessing / 预处理

本步骤把输入整理为后续五章直接读取的形式：解析 CSS 表、准备宿主树、
准备 alpha/β 缓存，并把只读服务器结果复制到 `result/`。
This step resolves CSS tables, host trees, alpha/beta caches and copies the
read-only server results into the result layout used by Chapters 1–5.

## 1. Inputs / 输入检查

```{r inputs}
required <- c(
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_16S.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_ITS.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_table_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_table_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_taxonomy_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_taxonomy_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "plant_tree", "species_all.nwk")
)
missing <- required[!file.exists(required)]
stopifnot(!length(missing))
cat(sprintf("inputs: %d required files present\n", length(required)))
```

## 2. CSS tables / CSS 表

随仓库提供的 `data/standard_*` 默认直接使用；缺失或设置
`SEED_RECOMPUTE=css` 时从 `filtered_*` 重算到 `result/prepared/`。
Shipped CSS tables are used by default; missing tables (or
`SEED_RECOMPUTE=css`) are regenerated from the filtered counts.

```{r css}
ensure_css(force = want_recompute("css"))
for (ds in c("16s", "its")) {
  f <- css_merged_path(paste0("css_", ds, "_asvtab.txt"))
  cat(sprintf("merged %s: %s (%.1f MB)\n", ds, f, file.size(f) / 1e6))
}
for (reg in c("its1", "its2", "v3_v4", "v4", "v5_v6", "v5_v7")) {
  f <- css_region_path(reg, paste0("css_", reg, "_asvtab.txt"))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
}
cat("six region CSS tables resolved\n")
```

## 3. Host trees / 宿主树

区段树与属级树由 TimeTree 导出树和 metadata 派生；随仓库提供的派生树
存在时直接复用。Region and genus trees are derived from the TimeTree export
and metadata; shipped derived trees are reused when available.

```{r host-trees}
ensure_host_trees()
for (f in c("plant_species_tree_all.nwk", "plant_species_tree_v4.nwk",
            "plant_species_tree_v5_v7.nwk", "plant_species_tree_its1.nwk",
            "plant_Genus_tree_all.nwk")) {
  tr <- ape::read.tree(host_tree_path(f))
  cat(sprintf("%-28s %5d tips\n", f, length(tr$tip.label)))
}
```

## 4. Alpha and beta caches / α、β 缓存

三个稿件区段的 alpha 多样性与 Bray-Curtis 距离默认读取随仓库缓存；
缺失或 `SEED_RECOMPUTE=alphabeta` 时从区段 CSS 表重算。
Alpha diversity and Bray-Curtis distances for the three manuscript regions
are read from the shipped cache; missing caches are recomputed from CSS.

```{r alpha-beta}
ensure_alpha_beta(force = want_recompute("alphabeta"))
for (reg in c("v4", "v5_v7", "its1")) {
  a <- readRDS(precomp_path(paste0("alpha_div_", reg, ".rds"), "alphabeta"))
  b <- readRDS(bray_path(reg))
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == attr(b, "Size"))
  cat(sprintf("%-6s alpha %5d samples; Bray %5d x %5d\n",
              reg, nrow(a), attr(b, "Size"), attr(b, "Size")))
}
```

## 5. Server results / 服务器结果

服务器结果只读，复制到各章读取的位置；文件缺失时停止并提示补交结果或
运行 `scripts/server/` 中的脚本。Server results are read-only and copied
into the result layout; missing files stop the run with a pointer to the
documented server scripts.

```{r server-assets}
materialize_server_assets(strict = TRUE)
srv <- c(
  "ch1/host_overview_tree.pdf",
  "ch2/mixed_pool_adonis.rds",
  "ch2/adonis/partA_units.rds",
  "ch2/adonis/partB_pools.rds",
  "ch2/beta/bray_dist_v4.rds",
  "ch2/beta/bray_dist_v5_v7.rds",
  "ch2/beta/bray_dist_its1.rds",
  "ch3/asv_ref_silva.nwk",
  "ch3/boot_lambda_samples.rds",
  "ch4/gos_hostn_pos_16s_midpoint.nwk",
  "ch4/Tab_4_tree_phylosig.tsv",
  "ch4/Tab_4_tree_generalist_D.tsv"
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(server_path(srv))))
cat(sprintf("server assets: %d required files present\n", length(srv)))
```

## 6. Run log / 运行记录

```{r log}
writeLines(c(
  paste("Preprocessing:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
  paste("PROJECT_ROOT:", PROJECT_ROOT),
  paste("R:", R.version.string),
  paste("SEED_RECOMPUTE:", paste(RECOMPUTE_STEPS, collapse = ",")),
  paste("SEED_ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE:", ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE),
  paste("CSS rebuilt:", want_recompute("css")),
  paste("alpha/beta rebuilt:", want_recompute("alphabeta"))
), file.path(RESULT_DIR, "logs", "preprocessing.log"))
cat("preprocessing complete\n")
```
